en: Color postcard showing a manicured central square with lawns, flowerbeds and a slender obelisk/clock column. Along the edge stands a long red‑brick historic building with two small domed pavilions (the main university building), while twin baroque church towers rise in the background. A rooftop neon reads "ECONOMISITI LA CEC." The reverse has Romanian preprinted address lines and a multilingual caption identifying Cluj‑Napoca and Victory Square.
